arguments.summary: Fixed versions/compare.py: the parser was returning version components as strings, so lexicographic comparison made "1.10.0" < "1.9.0" and "1.02.0" != "1.2.0". Changed `_parse` to return `[int(p) for p in parts]` and updated `compare`'s `zip_longest` fillvalue from `"0"` to `0` so padding works with...
